selected_evidence.summary: UCI dhcp.domain record app.internal=10.100.198.11 committed and dnsmasq restarted; nslookup from node1 itself resolves app.internal to 10.100.198.11; dnsmasq confirmed listening on 10.100.198.10:53 (br-lan), the interface shared with node2/node3

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 resolves and reaches app.internal:8080 without any local hosts-file entry
selected_evidence.summary: node3's NetworkManager DNS pointed at node1 (10.100.198.10); grep of /etc/hosts for app.internal returns nothing, while getent hosts and python socket.gethostbyname resolve it via DNS to 10.100.198.11, and curl to http://app.internal:8080/ returns 200 with node2's page

selected_evidence.requirement: node2's HTTP service on 8080 is real and reachable
selected_evidence.summary: Service was not actually running at task start; created systemd unit + firewalld port 8080, confirmed active and returning 200 locally and from node3's address space
